NYLOK
Manufacturing Engineering Internship
Non-Disclosure Agreement: I will only disclose non-proprietary information regarding my work at Nylok.

What I did: Helped design and bring a new production machine online, from mechanical tooling through vision-based quality control.


  • Designed tooling now installed and running in production
  • Built and trained vision inspection systems (pre- and post-application)
  • Established repeatable machine alignment and setup procedures
  • Contributed to PPAP readiness alongside a small team, mentored by Noah

Designed pick-and-place tooling to transfer six boxnuts at a time from the feed track into a mold, precise and repeatable at production speed.

Paired this with training the Keyence VS Creator vision system for:


  • A prototype inline camera simulation (including a custom-built power supply)
  • End-of-line inspection for quality assurance

Watching this go from a design problem to a reliable part of the production floor was one of the most rewarding moments of the internship.
